autoContext: Validates deriveTags action. Covers: contentKey param (key in previous_data for main text), contextKey param (optional secondary text at reduced weight), inline content param (fallback when contentKey absent), maxTags param (int, default 6), return format (comma-separated lowercase tags stored under id).

prepare_content._comment: Produce a content string to derive tags from.
prepare_content.command: echo machine learning neural network training dataset Python tensorflow

prepare_content._comment: Secondary context text to boost certain tags.

tags_from_content_key._comment: PARAM: contentKey — key in previous_data holding the main text to analyse. PARAM: maxTags defaults to 6. Returns comma-separated tag string.

tags_with_context._comment: PARAM: contextKey — optional secondary text. Tokens from contextKey are weighted at 0.4× relative to contentKey, biasing tags toward shared terms.

tags_inline._comment: PARAM: content — inline text fallback used when contentKey is absent or returns empty. No previous_data key needed.
tags_inline.content: docker container kubernetes orchestration deployment pipeline

tags_max_limited._comment: PARAM: maxTags — int controlling how many tags to return. Here limited to 3 instead of default 6.
